research.dailySignal: 今日共筛选出5篇达到阈值的研究，重点涉及肯尼亚梅鲁县女性早期宫颈癌筛查中醋酸肉眼观察与巴氏涂片检测的评价、DNA甲基化标志物检测宫颈癌前病变和宫颈癌的诊断准确性：系统评价与Meta分析、放疗前改良预后营养指数预测接受放疗的宫颈癌患者急性放射性肠炎：一项回顾性研究。以下内容用于研究情报追踪，单篇论文结论不等同于指南建议。

papers.title: Evaluation of visual inspection with acetic acid and Pap smear tests in early cervical cancer screening among women in Meru County, Kenya.
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Early cervical dysplasia screening can save women from death resulting from cervical cancer.
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate and compare the diagnostic performance of the Papanicolaou (Pap) smear and visual inspection with acetic acid (VIA) against histopathology as the reference test.
METHODS: We recruited 160 women aged 25-60 years who were undergoing early cervical screenings at the Meru teaching and referral hospital, from June to October 2024. The sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value (PPV), and negative predictive value (NPV) were calculated by comparing VIA and Pap smear outcomes against histology (gold standard).
RESULTS: Mean age of the study sample was 44.96 years (s.d. = 9.49). Eighteen (11%) had inflammation, 3 (1.9%) had squamous cell carcinoma against 11 (6.9%) detected by histology, and 14 (8.8%) had precancerous lesions. There was no statistical significance between age or number of pregnancies and histology-confirmed cervical lesions. Pap smear had a sensitivity of 100% (95% confidence interval [CI]: 86-100), specificity of 94% (95%CI: 89-97), PPV of 76% (95%CI: 58-89), and NPV of 100% (95%CI: 97-100). In comparison, VIA showed diagnostic performance with sensitivity of 72% (95%CI: 51-88), specificity of 81% (95%CI: 74-88), PPV of 42% (95%CI: 27-58), and NPV of 94% (95%CI: 88-98).
CONCLUSION: Pap smear showed higher overall diagnostic accuracy than VIA in diagnosing cervical lesions. While less specific, VIA showed a high NPV, suggesting its potential in ruling out disease in low-resource settings. Although age and pregnancy showed no statistical significance with cervical dysplasia, more studies including characteristics are required.
WHAT THIS STUDY ADDS: Results provide updated evidence on the relative diagnostic performance of VIA and Pap smear, to guide cervical cancer screening strategies in settings with limited resources.

summaryZh.titleZh: 肯尼亚梅鲁县女性早期宫颈癌筛查中醋酸肉眼观察与巴氏涂片检测的评价
summaryZh.researchQuestion: 评估并比较巴氏涂片（Pap smear）与醋酸肉眼观察（VIA）以组织病理学为参考标准的诊断性能。
summaryZh.studyDesign: 诊断试验准确性评价研究（VIA和Pap smear结果与组织学金标准比较）
summaryZh.populationAndSample: 2024年6月至10月在肯尼亚Meru教学和转诊医院接受早期宫颈癌筛查的160名25-60岁女性；平均年龄44.96岁（标准差9.49）。
summaryZh.methods: 计算VIA和Pap smear与组织学（金标准）比较的灵敏度、特异度、阳性预测值（PPV）和阴性预测值（NPV）。
summaryZh.keyResults: 18例（11%）有炎症，3例（1.9%）有鳞状细胞癌，组织学检出11例（6.9%）鳞状细胞癌，14例（8.8%）有癌前病变；年龄或妊娠次数与组织学确认的宫颈病变之间无统计学显著性。Pap smear灵敏度100%（95%CI 86-100）、特异度94%（95%CI 89-97）、PPV 76%（95%CI 58-89）、NPV 100%（95%CI 97-100）；VIA灵敏度72%（95%CI 51-88）、特异度81%（95%CI 74-88）、PPV 42%（95%CI 27-58）、NPV 94%（95%CI 88-98）。
summaryZh.limitations: 摘要未报告明确的局限性；作者提出仍需开展纳入更多特征的研究。
summaryZh.clinicalInterpretation: 本研究中Pap smear诊断宫颈病变的总体准确性高于VIA；VIA虽然特异度较低但NPV较高，提示其在资源有限环境中可能具有排除病变的潜在价值。作者认为这些结果可为资源有限地区的宫颈癌筛查策略提供最新证据。

papers.title: Diagnostic Accuracy of DNA Methylation Markers for Detecting Cervical Precancer and Cervical Cancer: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: DNA methylation markers have been proposed as molecular triage tools for detecting cervical precancer and cancer, particularly among HPV-positive women. However, diagnostic performance varies across markers, assays, specimens, and clinical settings. This study aimed to evaluate the marker-specific diagnostic accuracy of DNA methylation markers and methylation panels for detecting CIN2+ and CIN3+ in cervical cancer screening, triage, and related diagnostic contexts.
METHODS: This systematic review and diagnostic test accuracy meta-analysis was reported according to PRISMA-DTA 10. Marker-specific analyses were performed separately by endpoint to avoid double counting. Pooled sensitivity, specificity, diagnostic odds ratio, clinical utility estimates, risk of bias, publication bias, and certainty of evidence were assessed using diagnostic test accuracy methods, QUADAS-2 11, Deeks' test 14, and GRADE-DTA 12,13.
RESULTS: The broad main diagnostic meta-analysis included 74 eligible studies 15-88, contributing 260 diagnostic test accuracy comparisons across 130 marker-endpoint-sample analyses. A strict sensitivity dataset included 164 comparisons from 51 studies. Seven marker analyses were available for CIN2+ and seven for CIN3+. Diagnostic performance varied by marker and endpoint. For CIN2+, S5 EPB41L3 plus HPV16/18/31/33 methylation showed the highest sensitivity but lower specificity, whereas PAX1, JAM3, SOX1, PAX1/JAM3, and Six-gene/GynTect showed higher specificity. For CIN3+, S5 showed the highest sensitivity, while PAX1/JAM3, JAM3, SOX1, PAX1, and Six-gene/GynTect had more balanced performance. Deeks' test did not show strong evidence of publication bias for most analyses, although borderline findings were observed in selected marker-endpoint analyses. GRADE-DTA certainty was low or very low across marker-endpoint analyses.
CONCLUSIONS: DNA methylation markers showed heterogeneous diagnostic accuracy for detecting CIN2+ and CIN3+. Some markers demonstrated potentially useful sensitivity- or specificity-oriented profiles, but certainty of evidence was low or very low. Further standardized prospective validation is required before routine clinical implementation.

summaryZh.titleZh: DNA甲基化标志物检测宫颈癌前病变和宫颈癌的诊断准确性：系统评价与Meta分析
summaryZh.researchQuestion: 评估DNA甲基化标志物及甲基化组合在宫颈癌筛查、分流及相关诊断背景下检测CIN2+和CIN3+的标志物特异性诊断准确性。
summaryZh.studyDesign: 系统评价与诊断试验准确性Meta分析（依据PRISMA-DTA 10报告）
summaryZh.populationAndSample: 主要诊断Meta分析纳入74项符合条件的研究，贡献260项诊断试验准确性比较，涵盖130项标志物-终点-样本分析；严格敏感性数据集包括来自51项研究的164项比较。
summaryZh.methods: 按终点分别进行标志物特异性分析以避免重复计数；使用诊断试验准确性方法汇总灵敏度、特异度、诊断比值比和临床效用估计，并采用QUADAS-2 11评估偏倚风险、Deeks检验14评估发表偏倚、GRADE-DTA 12,13评估证据确定性。
summaryZh.keyResults: 可获得CIN2+的7项标志物分析和CIN3+的7项标志物分析。诊断性能因标志物和终点而异。对于CIN2+，S5 EPB41L3联合HPV16/18/31/33甲基化显示最高灵敏度但较低特异度，而PAX1、JAM3、SOX1、PAX1/JAM3和Six-gene/GynTect显示较高特异度。对于CIN3+，S5显示最高灵敏度，而PAX1/JAM3、JAM3、SOX1、PAX1和Six-gene/GynTect表现更均衡。Deeks检验未显示大多数分析存在强发表偏倚证据，但在部分特定标志物-终点分析中观察到临界结果。GRADE-DTA证据确定性在所有标志物-终点分析中为低或极低。
summaryZh.limitations: 摘要报告证据确定性为低或极低，且诊断性能在不同标志物、检测方法、标本和临床场景中存在差异；常规临床实施前需要进一步标准化前瞻性验证。其他具体局限性摘要未报告。
summaryZh.clinicalInterpretation: DNA甲基化标志物在检测CIN2+和CIN3+方面显示出异质性的诊断准确性，部分标志物表现出可能有用的以灵敏度或特异度为导向的特征，但证据确定性低或极低，尚不能作为常规临床实施依据，需进一步标准化前瞻性验证。

papers.title: Pre-radiotherapy modified prognostic nutritional index predicts acute radiation enteritis in patients with cervical cancer undergoing radiotherapy: A retrospective study.
papers.abstract: Acute radiation enteritis (ARE) is a common complication of pelvic radiotherapy in patients with cervical cancer and may adversely affect treatment tolerance and nutritional status. The present retrospective study investigated whether the pre-radiotherapy modified prognostic nutritional index (mPNI), a cholesterol-modified nutritional and immune-related score, is associated with ARE in patients with cervical cancer receiving radiotherapy. A total of 92 patients with pathologically confirmed cervical cancer who completed radiotherapy at Fuyang People's Hospital Affiliated to Anhui Medical University (Fuyang, China) between January 2023 and December 2025 were included. ARE was graded according to the Radiation Therapy Oncology Group acute lower gastrointestinal toxicity criteria, with grade ≥1 ARE defined as the primary endpoint. Sensitivity analyses were conducted using grade ≥2 and grade ≥3 ARE as more clinically relevant endpoints. mPNI was calculated from pre-radiotherapy total cholesterol level, albumin level and total lymphocyte count. During radiotherapy, 67 patients developed grade ≥1 ARE. Pre-radiotherapy mPNI was higher in the ARE group than in the non-ARE group [median, 88.27 (interquartile range, 81.26-97.02) vs. 76.41 (interquartile range, 70.22-80.38); P<0.001]. In the clinically adjusted logistic regression model, a higher mPNI remained significantly associated with grade ≥1 ARE [odds ratio (OR), 1.163; 95% confidence interval (CI), 1.072-1.261; P<0.001]. Sensitivity analyses likewise demonstrated significant associations between mPNI and grade ≥2 ARE (OR, 1.069; 95% CI, 1.023-1.117; P=0.003) and grade ≥3 ARE (OR, 1.071; 95% CI, 1.013-1.133; P=0.016). Receiver operating characteristic curve analysis showed good discriminatory performance for grade ≥1 ARE, with an area under the curve of 0.835 (95% CI, 0.732-0.917), an optimal cut-off value of 80.406, a sensitivity of 79.1% and a specificity of 76.0%. These findings suggest that pre-radiotherapy mPNI may serve as a practical laboratory-based indicator for identifying patients with cervical cancer at increased risk of developing ARE during radiotherapy.

summaryZh.titleZh: 放疗前改良预后营养指数预测接受放疗的宫颈癌患者急性放射性肠炎：一项回顾性研究
summaryZh.researchQuestion: 探讨放疗前改良预后营养指数（mPNI）是否与接受放疗的宫颈癌患者发生急性放射性肠炎（ARE）相关。
summaryZh.populationAndSample: 92例于2023年1月至2025年12月在安徽医科大学附属阜阳人民医院完成放疗并经病理确诊的宫颈癌患者；放疗期间67例发生≥1级ARE。
summaryZh.methods: ARE根据放射治疗肿瘤学组急性下消化道毒性标准分级，主要终点为≥1级ARE，敏感性分析使用≥2级和≥3级ARE作为更临床相关的终点。mPNI由放疗前总胆固醇、白蛋白水平和总淋巴细胞计数计算。采用临床校正的logistic回归模型和接受者操作特征曲线分析。
summaryZh.keyResults: 放疗前mPNI在ARE组高于非ARE组[中位数88.27（四分位距81.26-97.02） vs 76.41（70.22-80.38）；P<0.001]。校正临床因素后，较高mPNI与≥1级ARE显著相关[比值比（OR）1.163；95%置信区间（CI）1.072-1.261；P<0.001]。敏感性分析显示mPNI与≥2级ARE（OR 1.069；95%CI 1.023-1.117；P=0.003）及≥3级ARE（OR 1.071；95%CI 1.013-1.133；P=0.016）显著相关。ROC曲线对≥1级ARE的曲线下面积为0.835（95%CI 0.732-0.917），最佳截断值为80.406，灵敏度79.1%，特异度76.0%。
summaryZh.clinicalInterpretation: 放疗前mPNI可能作为识别宫颈癌患者放疗期间发生ARE风险增加的实用实验室指标，但该关联来自回顾性研究，不能推断因果关系。

papers.title: The potential benefits of yoga for psychological well-being among people facing infertility.
papers.abstract:
INTRODUCTION: Infertility is a global health concern affecting millions of persons, and is associated with psychological strains, including anxiety, stress and depressive symptoms. Women undergoing investigation and Artificial Reproductive Technologies may seek complementary interventions, such as yoga, to support psychological well-being.
AIM: The aim of this scoping review was to map and synthesize the existing research on the use of yoga among women undergoing investigation and/or treatment for infertility, and to identify reported outcomes and research gaps.
METHOD: A scoping review was conducted according to JBI methodology and reported in accordance with the PRISMA-ScR checklist. Systematic searches were performed in CINAHL, PubMed and Web of Science for articles published between 2014 and 2025. Studies examining yoga interventions among women with infertility were included and charted.
RESULTS: Three studies involving a total of 297 women met the inclusion criteria. The studies were conducted in Canada, Italy and Turkey and applied different yoga interventions, primarily Hatha yoga. The findings of this study are presented under two main categories: Characteristics of study samples and interventions and Impact of yoga on mental health indicators and quality of life. None of the included studies assessed pregnancy or fertility treatment outcomes.
CONCLUSION: Yoga appears to be a promising complementary intervention for reducing psychological distress among women experiencing infertility. However, the limited number of valuable studies and heterogeneity of study designs highlight the need for further research, particularly regarding long-term effects and reproductive outcomes.
papers.journal: Sexual & reproductive healthcare : official journal of the Swedish Association of Midwives

summaryZh.titleZh: 瑜伽对面临不孕症人群心理健康的潜在益处
summaryZh.researchQuestion: 绘制并综合关于接受不孕症检查和/或治疗期间使用瑜伽的现有研究，并报告已报道的结局和研究空白。
summaryZh.studyDesign: 范围综述（遵循JBI方法学，并根据PRISMA-ScR清单报告）
summaryZh.populationAndSample: 3项研究，共涉及297名女性；研究在加拿大、意大利和土耳其进行。
summaryZh.methods: 系统检索CINAHL、PubMed和Web of Science，纳入2014年至2025年间发表、针对不孕女性瑜伽干预的研究；发现结果按两个主要类别呈现：研究样本和干预措施特征、瑜伽对心理健康指标和生活质量的影响。
summaryZh.keyResults: 三项研究符合纳入标准，应用了不同的瑜伽干预，主要是哈他瑜伽。所有纳入研究均未评估妊娠或生育治疗结局。瑜伽似乎是减少经历不孕的女性心理困扰的一种有前景的补充干预，但由于研究数量有限且研究设计存在异质性，需进一步开展研究，特别是关于长期效果和生殖结局的研究。
summaryZh.limitations: 摘要未单独列局限性，但指出纳入研究数量有限、研究设计异质性大，缺乏妊娠或生育治疗结局的评估。
summaryZh.clinicalInterpretation: 瑜伽可能作为减少不孕女性心理困扰的有前景的补充干预，但现有证据有限且异质性大，不能将其作为临床指令或确定性推荐。

papers.title: Gestational diabetes mellitus and life-course health.
papers.abstract: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM), traditionally defined as a disorder of hyperglycaemia with first onset or recognition during pregnancy, is a common condition which is complicated, costly, and controversial. Advances in understanding and awareness of GDM pathophysiology are resulting in an increasingly loud call for the application of personalised medicine approaches to both research in, and clinical care of, GDM. There is a shift away from viewing GDM as a condition to be diagnosed at 24 weeks of gestation and followed until 12 weeks postpartum, to a condition of metabolic vulnerability that precedes pregnancy, persists after pregnancy and requires a precision, life-course approach for health optimization facilitated by integrated, health system-wide supports. This article reviews emerging areas of focus in GDM with an emphasis on the relationship between the development of GDM and future health complications. The terms woman and women, mother and maternal are used in this paper to refer to all those, regardless of gender, who can or have become pregnant.
papers.journal: American journal of obstetrics & gynecology MFM

summaryZh.titleZh: 妊娠期糖尿病与生命全程健康
summaryZh.researchQuestion: 综述妊娠期糖尿病（GDM）的新兴关注领域，重点强调GDM发展与未来健康并发症之间的关系。
summaryZh.studyDesign: 综述文章（Journal Article/Review；具体综述类型摘要未报告）
summaryZh.methods: 摘要未报告具体方法；本文回顾了GDM的新兴关注领域，并强调GDM发生与未来健康并发症之间的关系。
summaryZh.keyResults: GDM传统上定义为妊娠期首次发生或首次识别的高血糖症，是一种常见、复杂、昂贵且有争议的疾病。对GDM病理生理学的理解和认识进展正促使人们越来越强烈地呼吁在GDM研究和临床护理中应用个体化医学方法。视角正从将GDM视为妊娠24周诊断并随访至产后12周的状况，转变为一种先于妊娠存在、妊娠后持续存在的代谢脆弱状态，需要通过整合的全卫生系统范围支持，采用精准、生命全程的方法来优化健康。本文使用woman/women、mother/maternal术语指代所有可能怀孕或已经怀孕的人，无论性别。
summaryZh.clinicalInterpretation: 本文为综述观点，提出GDM应被视为孕前-孕期-产后延续的代谢脆弱状态，并需要生命全程的精准管理；上述内容为作者对领域发展方向的论述，不构成临床指南或指令。
